text:
Maya: Heads-up — AtlasVR flagged INV-2026-04-22. They say reserved commit undercounted during an eu-west failover and they were billed burst charges. Asking for a one-time invoice override.

Jorge: assigning to @liang for usage recon. Can you pull pool logs for 2026-04-10 02:00-03:00 UTC? :eyes:

Liang: on it. initial glance shows cross-zone failover + duplicate meter tagging. possible double-count for pool-az2-004. I'll paste a small snippet in a sec.

Liang: ```usage_ids:
pool-az1-007: 32789
pool-az2-004: 65512
```Looks like a spike from warm restart retries, logs show repeated ingestion attempts.

Amy: if it's duplicate counting we can do a billing adjustment + SLA credit. Need amount calc + approval from finance lead.

Finance-bot: Note: automatic SLA credits <= 15% of monthly commit. Manual override requires finance director signoff.

Jorge: rough estimate: ~$21,400 in burst charges tied to the window + potential 10% SLA credit. @maya - propose we cover the duplicate burst lines and grant a 10% credit given their long-term commit.

Maya: recommend full adjustment for duplicated burst line items and 10% SLA credit. AtlasVR has been on a Dedicated commit since 2024-Q3 — good customer.

Amy: ok I'll draft a credit memo. For any credit > $10k we need a written approval. @jorge can you confirm exact charge ids and a brief justification?

Jorge: confirmed charge ids: CHG-9981, CHG-9982, CHG-9983. Cause: duplicate ingestion during failover. Supporting logs and the recon worksheet are in ticket #4027 (internal).

Maya: +1 for adjustment. Route the memo to finance-approvals with subject: "AtlasVR - duplicate meter correction". Mention the failover window and attach logs.

Amy: Draft uploaded to finance drive and queued for approvals. /notify finance-approvals :white_check_mark: 

Liang: engineering note — we've identified the tagging race condition and will roll a fix to the ingestion tagging logic. ETA: end of week. This should prevent recurrence.

Finance-bot: Approval required from finance-director (sam). CC legal if you include contractual language. Use internal CLI: `/approve-credit <ticket>` to record signoff.

Sam: Approved. Please process the adjustment and apply the 10% SLA credit to AtlasVR's next invoice cycle.

Maya: Thanks team. @amy please update the customer (keep it factual: corrected meter counts, applied credit, mitigation in progress) and close ticket #4027 once done. I'll follow up with engineering on the long-term mitigation.

Amy: Will do, updating now and sending the customer note.
